name: Risshuu
source:
Memories of a single summer.
When summer starts, a girl from the city comes to my house to play.
I look forward to it every year.
But this year, I just can't control my emotions anymore.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE037671.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
一个夏日的回忆。
夏天开始时，城里来的女孩会来到我家玩。
我每年都期待着这一天。
可是今年，我再也控制不住自己的感情了。

[摘自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE037671.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
